photos.c: Above: Making a big impact on the Belgrave Race Walking scene, Mabon Dane joined from Colchester in December 1995 and is already our 10k Track Champion. He led for almost the whole of the race but was pipped by guest competitor G.Jones of New Zealand (here tracking him closely).
